description: Election Commission - Mr. A. C. K. Abesekara of the Padaviya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Padaviya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local government elections, specifically fitting Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
